svg.title: Step 7 mockup 08: Standings, the final and the player cards (organiser)
svg.text: 08 · Standings, the final cut, the final and the player cards (organiser)
Use case: an organiser checks the standings before Sunday, confirms the 4 finalists, scores the final and adds the champions' photos; each finalist has a lively player card. Demo names only.

g.text: Demo Game Cup · standings after 5 of 6 sessions
the cut: the top 4 play the final
Points = placing + awards: 14 (12+2) is 12 from placing and 2 from an MVP award. Open a row for the breakdown.
Places 4 and 5 are tied on every rule, on the cut
The rules say a tie-break game decides; record its winner here.
Sun 13:00 · Stage · 4 finalists · final ranks decide the champion
PHOTOS · SHOWN ON THE WINNER CARD AND THE CHAMPIONS PAGE · TAKEN BY THE CREW
Crowning saves the final's result: the hall screen plays the champion moment. A tagged person can ask for a photo's removal.

svg.text: 3 · The player card: the finalist intro and the spotlight use the same card
The standings use the 3 / 2 / 1 / 0 default plus awards; the cut is a setting, 4 finalists by default,
confirmed by the organiser, never locked by itself.
Tie-break chain: more wins, then more sessions, then a crew-recorded game.
Photos are taken by the crew and shown on the winner card and the champions page; there is no consent
tick. A tagged person can ask for removal, and the crew moderates.
The player card: nickname, a motto the player sets, avatar, achievement badges (MVPs, podiums, streaks,
first win), season points and best result. The same card feeds the finalist intro on the screen and the
